# Briefing: Tony Dillon, VLink Inc.

## Identity (well established)
- **Goes by "Tony" and "Anthony" interchangeably.** Appears as "Anthony Dillon" on LinkedIn and VLink's podcast/webinar pages, and as "Tony Dillon" on VLink's leadership page and in the Microsoft press release. His VLink speaker headshot file is literally `Tony-D.jpg` with alt text "Tony Dillon VLink", tying the two names to one person. (high confidence)
- **The full name "George Anthony Dillon" could not be verified anywhere.** No search found it connected to VLink or Microsoft. Treat that version of the name as unconfirmed.
- **Title:** "AVP – Partnership Alliance" on VLink's leadership page; "AVP Solution Sales & Partnerships" in the Sep 2025 Microsoft release. (high confidence)

## LinkedIn
- **URL: https://www.linkedin.com/in/anthony-dillon** (slug confirmed via his own post URLs; the profile itself sits behind LinkedIn's authwall, so details came from search-result snippets).
- **Current headline:** "Enterprise & Partner Sales Leader | Cloud & AI Transformation | Ex Microsoft", company line "AVP - Solution Sales & Partnership Alliance · VLink Inc", location "Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex". (high confidence)
- An older headline snapshot: "Sales Strategy & Business Development Executive | Technology Solutions Specialist | Ex Microsoft". (medium-high)
- Self-summary (via snippet): "I lead enterprise sales and partnership strategy focused on cloud and AI, with a track record of driving growth in complex, high-stakes environments."

## Career background
- **Ex-Microsoft, and that is the headline credential.** A LinkedIn recommendation from Carson V. Heady says verbatim: "I've been fortunate to work with Tony across multiple projects during our time at Microsoft... customer obsession make him an invaluable asset." (high confidence)
- **"20+ years in tech"**, per VLink's own podcast page. (high confidence)
- **Channel/partner-sales specialist.** Recommendation from Karen Bowie Washington, MBA: "Anthony is a dynamic channel partner specialist... incredible relationship builder with National channel expertise." (high confidence)
- **Joined VLink around 2025** (his own post "How a recruiter helped me find my next role at VLink", dated roughly a year ago). (medium)
- **Certifications** (from his public LinkedIn profile): CompTIA A+; CompTIA Project+; ITIL v3 Foundation; Microsoft Certified: AI Business Professional; Dynamics 365 Fundamentals; Power Platform Fundamentals. (high confidence)
- **Education and prior employers beyond Microsoft: NOT FOUND.** The LinkedIn experience section is auth-walled and ZoomInfo/Datanyze are blocked.

## Location
- **Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex** (LinkedIn location). No specific city confirmed. (high confidence)
- Note the mismatch worth holding in mind: VLink is a Connecticut HQ company and the Microsoft release was datelined South Windsor, CT. A DFW-based exec at a CT-HQ firm is consistent, but **the DFW residence is sourced only from his LinkedIn location field.**

## Public mentions
- **Press release, Sep 17, 2025:** "VLink Achieves Microsoft Solutions Partner Designation for Digital & App Innovation (Azure)." He is the quoted executive and the media contact. Verbatim: "This designation reinforces our ability to deliver transformative cloud solutions that allow organizations to move beyond legacy systems..." Contact number listed is **+1 773-398-0061, a Chicago (773) area code**, not Dallas. Syndicated on EIN Presswire, salestechstar.com, menafn.com. (high confidence)
- **Podcast guest:** "Tech Talk with VLink" Ep. 52, "The Microsoft Advantage: Turning Partnerships into Client Outcomes," April 7, 2026, host Tracy Gardner. (high confidence) On iHeart, Spotify, Amazon Music, Pocket Casts.
- **Webinar panelist and host:** "Architecting the AI-Ready Enterprise: Decisions That Matter," March 10, 2026. Listed as "Anthony Dillon, AVP, Solution Partnerships & IT Strategy - VLink; Director & Host, Tech Webinars." (high confidence)
- **VLink social content:** LinkedIn video "Cloud Partnerships Deliver Real Business Impact with VLink" (roughly 5 months ago); "The Microsoft Tech Minute" series. (existence high, dates medium)

## VLink company background
- **HQ: South Windsor, Connecticut** (701 John Fitch Blvd), not Glastonbury. About page: "our headquarters outside Hartford, CT." (high confidence)
- **US offices: South Windsor, CT and Framingham, MA only.** A full sitemap search for Dallas/Texas/DFW/Irving/Plano/Frisco/Austin/Houston returned **zero matches.** (high confidence) **There is no verifiable Texas office.**
- International: India (Gurugram, Noida, Bengaluru), Canada (Mississauga, ON), Indonesia, Singapore.
- **Founded 2006** (self-reported in the Oct 2024 release). Founder name not confirmed. **Privately held, MBE-certified minority-owned business.** President & CEO: **Sharad Patney**. Global CMO: Tracy Gardner.
- **Size:** figures conflict across their own pages: LinkedIn lists **644 employees**; the site claims 800+/850+ certified professionals and "650+ Microsoft-certified consultants." Revenue not public.
- **Microsoft partnership:** **Microsoft Solutions Partner for Digital & App Innovation (Azure)** (announced Sep 2025, high confidence). LinkedIn company page also claims **Data & AI** Solutions Partner (self-reported). Site markets itself as an **Azure Expert MSP** and authorized Microsoft licensing partner (vendor claims, not independently verified against Microsoft's directory). **No Microsoft Partner of the Year status found.**
- **Services:** IT staffing, digital/software engineering, Azure cloud and managed services, Data & AI (Power BI, Synapse, Copilot), cybersecurity/compliance, Power Platform, Microsoft licensing. No evidence of SAP or ServiceNow practices.

## Golf and personal interests
- **No golf connection found for Tony Dillon himself.** Searches for his name plus golf, Dallas, Microsoft, VLink all returned nothing attributable. (high confidence nothing public exists)
- The only golf item is a **company** sponsorship of the **2017 Travelers Championship** (PGA TOUR, Cromwell, CT), framed around charity. Do not attribute this to him personally.
- **No charity tournaments or hobbies tied to him.** No useful personal-interest material surfaced for small talk.

## Excluded (other Tony Dillons)
The following were identified and discarded as unrelated: the Irish footballer; a game developer; an ATO/CRM consultant in Australia; a UK Sykes Holiday Cottages AI strategist; a UK business coach ("always possible"); an SHRM-SCP at Bocar in Alabama; an aviation consultant in Sydney; an Ireland program manager; a Little Rock home builder / ex-AT&T; and a Chicago-area Whitepages resident. None are the VLink executive.

## Confidence summary
- **Solid:** identity as one VLink person, DFW LinkedIn location, ex-Microsoft background, current title, the Sep 2025 Microsoft Solutions Partner release, VLink HQ and size range.
- **Uncertain / not found:** the "George Anthony Dillon" full name (unverified), education, prior employers beyond Microsoft, specific DFW city, revenue, founder identity, the "Azure Expert MSP" and "Data & AI" credentials (company-asserted only), and any personal golf/hobby detail.

## Practical read for the golf event
Conversation-safe anchors: his Microsoft alumni status and partner-sales focus, the Sep 2025 Digital & App Innovation (Azure) designation, and "Tech Talk with VLink" / "Tech Webinars" hosting. Do not assume he lives in Dallas proper or that VLink has a Texas office. Do not bring up golf as *his* hobby, since nothing supports it.
